newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Bomb explosion kills Cyprus bar owner.
newsitem.headline: Bomb explosion kills Cyprus bar owner.

text.p: A Cypriot bar owner was killed on Friday after a bomb exploded in his garage as he was parking his car, police said.
Petros Yiannaki, 32, was severely injured when the explosion occurred early in the morning in the southeastern coastal town of Paralimni. He died minutes later in a nearby hospital.
"He had repeated run-ins with the police in the past for different offences," said police spokesman Stelios Neophytou.
